subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should this PR be treated as the canonical landing candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877 instead of the other open candidate PRs?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same retry bug, and deterministic review can say this branch is viable but cannot pick the landing branch on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Refresh/rebase the current head, keep the per-attempt metadata approach, and close the other candidate PRs after this lands.

options.title: Select another candidate PR
options.body: Keep this PR open only until maintainers choose and land a different viable candidate for the linked issue.

options.title: Pause all candidate PRs
options.body: Hold the cluster if maintainers want a different retry-safety design than current-attempt replay metadata.

recommendation.body: Refresh/rebase the current head, keep the per-attempt metadata approach, and close the other candidate PRs after this lands.
